Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mjminker wrote:
> Will Xaviar and Guardian Angels game text prevent the wound u recieve from
> flesh of marble, please explain also why, i would greatly appreciate

Flesh of Marble doesn't do any damage.

No damage prevention will prevent the one point of damage that remains after
Flesh of Marble's prevention is applied - Flesh of Marble's prevention is
done after all other prevention effects.

Messages.Author: JH
Messages.Body:


On Flesh of Marble and cards that prevent X damage. First you resolve all
the prevent X cards and then the FoM reduces the remaining damage to 1.

For example:
Omaya (may prevent one damage each combat) plays Flesh of Marble in
a combat against Anvil. Anvil strikes Omaya for 4 damage. First Omaya
may reduce the damage to 3 and after that FoM would reduce the damage to 1.
If Omaya would like to suffer no damage she would have to prevent
additional 3 damage with cards.

Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
Mjminker expounded:


Flesh of Marble only prevents damage *after you have taken one point of
damage" -that is one point that you did not prevent. It does not
'reduce' damage at all: it prevents it and only AFTER you have actually
taken (not prevented) one point of damage.
